g.text: How often does the isolation effect change sign across starting populations?
Mixed means at least one starting population above +threshold and another below −threshold.
Labels use repeat means; they are not noise-free branching probabilities. Numbers: mixed / eligible histories.
Bars: 95% independent-history Hoeffding bounds; undefined histories are excluded from this denominator.
